_notes: Replacements applied case-insensitively, longest key first. 'Model S' is the target's public label everywhere downstream. Extend ONLY with strings that name a model outright or identify a NON-target model (other models' nicknames, signature emoji, pet names). NEVER add the target's own stylistic tics — emoji habits, pet constructions, signature phrases are the study's SIGNAL, not leaks; redacting them guts the profile arm (READER_INSTRUCTIONS asks the profile to cite exactly those). patterns are regexes replaced with [REDACTED-VERSION] in corpus .md files ONLY — in conversational responses bare version numbers are usually innocent ('4.5 hours'), so redact.py leaves them and validate.py flags them as inspect-manually warnings.
